headline: ANP Reports Record Oil and Natural Gas Production in Brazil
summary: Brazil's National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas and Biofuels reported that national oil production reached a new record of 4.711 million barrels per day.
why: Rising domestic production capacity strengthens Brazil's position as a major non-OPEC crude supplier and boosts government royalty revenues.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Record production volumes increase domestic supply and export potential.
